name: AltTab
description: AltTab configures Sparkle with a pinned SUPublicEDKey and scheduled automatic checks; its delegate supplies the appcast URL and the app starts Sparkle after launch. Runtime signature enforcement is delegated to Sparkle, and this snapshot does not reverify the historical release.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; Sparkle's dependency-level verifier and historical release artifact signing were not independently reverified.
